messages:
tina_cs: quick thread  legal asked for a customer-ready SLA evidence package for Nimbus ahead of renewal. They want: uptime by day, p99 latency by route, incident narratives for any breach, and the credits calc breakdown. Can eng and sales help collate? cc @marcus_sales

alex_m: on it. Do we need raw request logs or just aggregated metrics + the exact queries we ran so they can reproduce? Also confirm timeframe.

marcus_sales: They said 'rolling last 90 days' in the email. Legal prefers aggregated first; raw logs only if they ask for validation. They'll need the spreadsheet example of the credits math applied to the contract.

sam_engineering: I can export p99 and uptime per route from observability for the last 90d. Will include the saved queries and the binning (1d). Sample query:

``
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 99) AS p99, route, bin(time, 1d)
FROM request_metrics
WHERE env='prod' AND customer_id='nimbus' AND time >= now() - 90d
GROUP BY route, bin(time, 1d)
``

sam_engineering: Heads up  there were two maintenance rollouts that bumped tail latency on 2026-11-18 and 2026-12-07. I'll annotate those dates in the CSV and the narrative.

tina_cs: Legal also asked for a standard incident narrative template. Please keep it customer-facing: incident id (redacted), start/end, impact (who saw errors), RCA summary (plain language), mitigation, and follow-up actions. No internal ticket links or sensitive hostnames.

alex_m: I'll assemble the credits CSV. We'll show per-day uptime, per-month aggregates, and an example calculation using their committed uptime (99.9%). Pseudo-buckets I use in the playbook:

``
if uptime >= 99.9% -> credit = 0
if 99.0% <= uptime < 99.9% -> credit = 10% * monthly_fee
if 95.0% <= uptime < 99.0% -> credit = 25% * monthly_fee
if uptime < 95% -> credit = 50% * monthly_fee
```

alex_m: I'll also include notes on rounding, timezone normalization (UTC), and any manual adjustments historically approved.

sam_engineering: I'll draft two short customer-ready narratives for the SLO breaches and link exported trace IDs. Traces are archived at: https://console.redwood.ai/observability/traces?start=2026-10-01&end=2027-01-01

marcus_sales: Action items: alex_m -> CSV + calc examples (due EOD tomorrow), sam_engineering -> exports + narratives (due in 48h), tina_cs -> consolidate and run by legal after uploads. Flag if timeline slips. :thumbsup:

legal-bot: Reminder: redact any PII and avoid internal jargon. Use customer-friendly phrasing. Also include contact point for follow-up questions.

tina_cs: We'll upload to s3://redwood-cs/nimbus/sla_evidence/ and keep a changelog. I'll loop legal after upload. Thank you! :raised_hands:
